conbody.p: A troubleshooting topic documents corrective action by describing a problem, explaining its cause, and providing a remedy. The AI Agent classifies a section as troubleshooting when the content follows a clear Problem / Cause / Solution structure; where the pattern is ambiguous, the heuristic classifier may assign task or generic instead. The generated topic uses <troubleshooting> with <troublebody>.
